description: This file is an implementation of a controller class for managing SEO URLs in the admin panel of an OpenCart e-commerce system. It handles listing, filtering, creating, editing, and deleting SEO URL entries, interacts with models and views, and manages routing and permissions.

classes.name: SeoUrl
classes.description: Controller class for managing SEO URL entities in the admin section, providing methods for listing, editing, creating, and deleting SEO URL records.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for the SEO URL management page, sets up the page title, loads language, and renders the list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX requests to retrieve and output the list of SEO URLs.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches and prepares data for displaying the list of SEO URLs, including filtering, sorting, pagination, and links.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Prepares and renders the form for creating or editing a SEO URL entry, filling in existing data if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes POSTed form data to create or update a SEO URL entry, including validation and permission checks.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of selected SEO URL entries, with permission validation.
